offspring_risk: A: every son, every daughter a carrier
findings_a: chrX:32218643 A>G hemizygous, Pathogenic, 2 stars, ClinVar 90000
explanation: A carries the change on both X chromosomes: every son inherits it and can have Duchenne and Becker muscular dystrophy; every daughter is a carrier.

findings_b: chr22:42051896 A>G het, Pathogenic, 2 stars, ClinVar 90000
explanation: Only B carries a change in NAGA (Schindler disease, autosomal recessive). A child can be a carrier like B, not affected, unless A carries a change this screen does not see.
